text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy grounds...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...It must be worthy of the Mejiro name... and above all,
I must extend heartfelt hospitality to them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*bump!*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, my sincere apologies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was merely deep in thought...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, McQueen!
...Wait, what's with the super serious face? Something up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, as a representative of the Mejiro family horse girls,
I am tasked with delivering a greeting to our foreign guests...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have been racking my brain trying to craft a speech
that will bring no dishonor to the Mejiro name, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~...
Now that you mention it, I feel like I heard about some party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Come with me!
Ah, since you're here, you too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the more the merrier, right?
Please, think of it as helping a girl out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I got some baseball tickets,
and I was wondering who I should go with~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I hardly have time to watch baseball right now...
To fool around instead of fulfilling my Mejiro duties would be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm a daughter of the Mejiro family too, y'know~
Even if I did try running away from home once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all the different things I experienced back then,
I feel like I was able to rediscover my true self.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, I was thinking maybe if you take a break and run away for a bit,
you might find the answer you're looking for, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your case was truly exceptional, desu wa...
However, I cannot simply run away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Pretty sure Grandma wants
happiness for all us Mejiro kids, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look, baseball has the "uncaught third strike" rule, right?
Where the batter can dash to first base even after swinging and missing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Turning a pinch into a chance—
that's what a "breakaway" escape is all about, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right now might feel like a pinch for you, McQueen,
but taking a bold escape might just become your golden chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... when you put it like that,
there are escapes of that nature...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally! Super valid!
Let's run away, escape, and clear our heads for a bit!
choice_data_list: Let's escape to the fullest just for today
Going at your own pace might be important

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right on! Having peace of mind
is exactly why you can break away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Understood, desu wa. If you insist so far,
I shall enjoy myself to the fullest today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Knock it out of the park! Yu-ta-kaaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nice, round the bases! Round 'em!
Run, run, run away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by taking a nice breather watching baseball,
Mejiro McQueen was able to fulfill her heavy responsibilities successfully.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Walking your own path no matter what
is what matters most!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The usual McQueen has an iron core
and an unwavering vibe that's super cool, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...You are quite right, desu wa. Even to carry out one's duties,
one must first regain one's own pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let's go, let's go, Yu-ta-kaaa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, getting hyped up now!
You're sounding like the true McQueen again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen had a wonderful change of pace,
and went on to deliver a truly magnificent speech.
